difficulty_reason: The lemma collects characterizations of additive, left exact, right exact and exact functors between abelian categories (statement lines 1761-1781). The proof is a complete argument: additivity of a one-sided exact functor follows from preservation of direct sums and the companion characterization (proof lines 1784-1786); the characterization of left exactness is proved by noting that the displayed exactness makes the functor additive, via the short exact sequence involving a direct sum and the induced commutative diagram, after which left exactness follows (proof lines 1787-1850); the third statement is the dual of the second and the fourth combines the two (proof lines 1852-1853). The non-formal content is the diagram argument for additivity. The claim is H2: a structured argument with the dual parts noted.
